_readme: Real photography for the site. .github/workflows/photos.yml downloads each at 3840px and commits it to public/images/photos/ (CI cannot reach unsplash.com page ids, so use 'cdn' for Unsplash or 'pexels' for Pexels). 'file' = a local photo instead. Unsplash and Pexels licences: free for commercial use, attribution optional.

harbour.alt: A city waterfront at sunset, the hero image of the Ironclad website

office-view.alt: A city skyline seen through the floor-to-ceiling windows of a high-rise office

dolomites-peaks.alt: A jagged Dolomites ridge lit gold by the setting sun

manhattan-dusk.alt: Midtown Manhattan and the Empire State Building at sunset, the harbour beyond
manhattan-dusk.note: Pexels 29297529, retouched to remove the Comcast and H&M rooftop signs

sea-sunset.alt: A golden sunset over the Arabian Sea off Goa
